about: Aqylon Nexus Ltd, formerly Sri Adhikari Brothers Television Network Ltd, emerged from insolvency resolution and changed control in November 2025. The company subsequently changed its name and shifted its focus from television content production and distribution to AI software, IT services and computing infrastructure. [1]
